description: Also called tool use. The model answers with a structured request to call a described tool; the application executes it and returns the result as context.
What the model sees about a tool: a `name`, a `description` and JSON Schema `parameters`. The implementation stays in your code.
`{ id, name, arguments }` in a model response. `arguments` is a raw JSON string written by the model, so it must be parsed and validated.
A `tool` role message carrying the result (or error) of one call, linked to it by `toolCallId`.
Several independent calls in one response. Execute all of them and return every result before calling the model again.
A request setting that lets the model decide (`auto`), forces a tool (`required` or a named tool) or forbids tools (`none`).
The maximum number of model calls in a tool loop. Reaching it raises an explicit error instead of looping forever.
